items.statement: The calculation uses the deposited 2453268/2453269 monomer identities and explicitly tracks neutral triplet and one-electron-reduced doublet states at the Cu atom.
items.expected: Both named records, state charges 0/-1, multiplicities 3/2, and the Cu atom are traceably identified.

items.statement: The submitted f_k+ values are supported by converged, consistently charge-partitioned neutral/reduced calculations.
items.expected: Convergence evidence and one consistent charge scheme are supplied for both systems, or a scientifically explicit bounded failure is reported.

items.statement: The Cu-centered local Fukui values are approximately 0.0182 for complex 1 and 0.0299 for complex 2.
items.expected: Reported values support 1≈0.0182 and 2≈0.0299 within method/reporting variation.

items.statement: The larger Cu f_k+ for complex 2 supports stronger Cu-centered substrate interaction and the reported higher catecholase activity, without proving the entire catalytic mechanism.
items.expected: Interpretation states 2 has greater Cu electrophilicity/local Fukui response and connects it cautiously to activity.
